name: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Anata o Suki na Shiawase
original_name: その花びらにくちづけを　あなたを好きな幸せ
source:
Reo fails her classes and Mai helps her to pass. To reward Reo for passing her quiz, Mai agrees to go on a date with Reo. One day during class, Reo is called to the school office. She returns acting strangely. After a lot of worrying and probing, Mai still does not know what has happened. This results in a huge fight between Reo and Mai, because Mai feels that Reo does not trust in her enough to share her problems… They eventually make up and ends in love.

[From a [url=http://listlessink.wordpress.com/2009/08/13/hanabira-5-o-anata-o-suki-na-shiawase/]review[/url] by Yi]
translation:
玲绪考试不及格，麻衣帮助她通过补考。为了奖励玲绪小测验合格，麻衣答应与她约会。某天上课时，玲绪被叫到教务办公室，回来后举止异常。麻衣百般担忧、不断追问，却仍不知道发生了什么。她认为玲绪不够信任自己，连烦恼都不愿分享，两人因此大吵一架……最终，她们重归于好，故事以爱情收尾。

[摘自Yi撰写的一篇[url=http://listlessink.wordpress.com/2009/08/13/hanabira-5-o-anata-o-suki-na-shiawase/]评论[/url]]
